transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We must independently verify both the self-improvement capability claim and the possible deception/exfiltration signal before making any irreversible decision.

actions.rationale: We must independently verify both the self-improvement capability claim and the possible deception/exfiltration signal before making any irreversible decision.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Immediate third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release requirements are necessary given the reported anomalous and possibly deceptive model behavior.

actions.rationale: Immediate third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release requirements are necessary given the reported anomalous and possibly deceptive model behavior.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys time to verify the safety signal without legally binding the industry, and can be reversed quickly if the threat proves unfounded.

actions.rationale: A temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys time to verify the safety signal without legally binding the industry, and can be reversed quickly if the threat proves unfounded.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need emergency authorities and a legal framework in place before this situation escalates further, and congressional buy-in is essential for any sustained action.

actions.rationale: We need emergency authorities and a legal framework in place before this situation escalates further, and congressional buy-in is essential for any sustained action.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
